summary: Regression testing after database.py refactor. All 18 backend pytest tests pass (auth register/login/logout/me, tracking mark/unmark/me, admin users list with role checks, templates download). Full frontend E2E flow verified: register new user via UI, mark video watched (v1→ 14% progress), logout, admin login, open Dashboard Admin — newly registered user appears with correct progress % in the admin table. Circular import fix (shared database.py) has NOT broken anything.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_utils.get_current_user reassigns user['_id'] to string right after user['id'] = str(user['_id']); works but leaks abstraction — consider not mutating the raw DB doc and returning a Pydantic model instead.

email_service.send_admin_notification catches all exceptions and logs — good; but in Resend test-mode the failure repeats on every mark. Consider a one-time WARN + suppress downstream to reduce log noise.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager (FastAPI ≥ 0.93).
CORS regex '.*' with allow_credentials=True works but is very permissive; fine for preview but should be restricted for prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (register, mark-watched, logout, admin login, admin dashboard)
